ABOUT US

Alexandria Kitchen and Bath Studio is an experienced design firm that will integrate innovative concepts into your home projects.

 

Although the basic function of a house is shelter, there is an art to transforming a collection of rooms into a home.  Making a kitchen “yours” means designing it exclusively for you.  It means understanding how you feel when you’re sipping that first morning cup, or enjoying a few scoops of Rocky Road at midnight.  It means creating a space that continuously welcomes you home.

 

While our primary focus is your kitchen and/or bathroom, we can also accommodate cabinetry needs throughout your home.  With a concern for function, we create alluring designs to transform your vision and wishes into reality and everyday life.

 

Our designers are certified National Kitchen and Bath Association members, and our installations are completed by our own experienced master carpenters and tradesmen.  The result is an efficient process that leads to timely and professional completion of projects.

 

Ranging from classic traditional to ultra-modern, and everything in-between, our variety of offerings from multiple manufacturers provide options for all tastes and styles.  Please come visit our Washington St. Alexandria, Virginia and let us help you turn your dreams into reality.
